page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9h.4xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs provided by a Hygon 7447v processor operating at a base frequency of 2.6 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application deployment. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 7 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated Hygon processor architecture provides a specialized hardware profile for workloads requiring dedicated x86_64 compute resources without the overhead of bundled local storage or GPU accelerators.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.c9h.4xlarge is designed for compute-bound workloads. Suitable applications include web serving, batch processing, application servers, and medium-scale computational tasks that do not require high memory capacity or local NVMe storage.
